invite.description: Configure user invitation and referral reward settings
invite.durationRewardCalcModeDescription: How the rewarded duration is calculated
invite.durationRewardCycleModeDescription: Which purchases of the invited user trigger a reward
invite.durationRewardEnabledDescription: Reward referrers with subscription duration instead of commission. Cash commission is replaced once enabled
invite.durationRewardExistingModeDescription: How to grant the duration when the inviter already has an active subscription
invite.durationRewardExtendModeDescription: Which subscription is extended first when several are active
invite.durationRewardFixedUnitDescription: Used when calculation is fixed duration
invite.durationRewardFixedValueDescription: Used when calculation is fixed duration
invite.durationRewardMinAmountDescription: Orders paid below this amount do not grant duration rewards. 0 means no limit
invite.durationRewardNoSubscribePolicyDescripti: What to do when the inviter has no active subscription
invite.durationRewardNotifyDescription: Send a notification to the inviter after the duration reward is granted
invite.durationRewardRatioDescription: Used when calculation is percentage, 100 means equal duration
invite.durationRewardScopeDescription: JSON scope, e.g. {"mode":"include","plans":[]}. Empty means all plans
invite.durationRewardTrafficModeDescription: How traffic is granted together with the duration
invite.forcedInviteDescription: When enabled, users must register through an invitation link
invite.inviteCodeCharsetDescription: Characters used by newly generated invitation codes
invite.inviteCodeLengthDescription: Length of newly generated invitation codes, 4-20. 0 uses the default of 8
invite.mergeCommissionToBalanceDescription: When enabled, commission is credited to balance directly instead of the commission wallet
invite.onlyFirstPurchaseDescription: When enabled, referrers only receive rewards for the first purchase by referred users
invite.referralPercentageDescription: Percentage of reward given to referrers
invite.title: Invitation Settings
invite.withdrawalMethodsDescription: JSON array of {"method","name","label","enabled"}. Leave empty to enable alipay, wechat and usdt
invite.withdrawalMinAmountDescription: 0 means no minimum. Commission below this amount cannot be withdrawn
